summary: The per-folder root ETag is persisted across restarts, so a launch no longer re-scans folders whose remote tree did not change.
changelog: The root ETag recorded by the interval gate is saved per folder in the app state directory and re-seeded on startup (issue #195).
Consequence: after a restart, the first remote-interval run skips the reconciliation when nothing changed remotely, instead of re-scanning the full tree.
